preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 200000 and 1 <= m <= 200000 for n, m in test_cases_params)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n (vertices) is between 2 and 2*10^5, and m (edges) is between 1 and 2*10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s <= n and 1 <= t <= n and s != t for (n, m, s, t) in test_cases_params)
preconditions.description: For each test case, start vertex s and end vertex t are valid distinct vertices within the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges) for edges in test_cases_edges)
preconditions.description: All edges connect distinct valid vertices within the range [1, n], ensuring no loops.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(tuple(sorted(e)) for e in edges)) == len(edges) for edges in test_cases_edges)
preconditions.description: The graph contains no multiple edges between any pair of vertices.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, m, s, t in test_cases_params) <= 200000 and sum(m for n, m, s, t in test_cases_params) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The sum of n and the sum of m across all test cases do not exceed 2*10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(is_connected(n, edges) for n, edges in zip([n for n, m, s, t in test_cases_params], test_cases_edges))
preconditions.description: Each graph is guaranteed to be connected.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip() == str(count_paths_mod(n, m, s, t, edges, MOD)) for line, (n, m, s, t, edges) in zip(output_lines, test_cases_data))
postconditions.description: Each output line is the count of paths from s to t with length L such that shortest_dist <= L <= shortest_dist + 1, modulo 10^9 + 7.
